findings.summary: pnpm build (tsc --noEmit && vite build) exits 1 on a single error outside this unit: server/report/pdfRenderer.ts(300,9) TS2322 Type 'Buffer<ArrayBufferLike>' is not assignable to type 'string' (PDFDocument info option). Re-ran 4 times (build, build2, tsc3, build4): same single error each time, zero errors in src/**. vite build alone exits 0. Not changed by this unit per the concurrent-work rule.

Previous-attempt finding (POST without body sent no Content-Type -> 415 json_required) is already fixed on disk: request() sets Content-Type application/json for every POST/PUT/PATCH and sends JSON.stringify(options.body ?? {}). historyApi archive/restore use httpClient.post without body and inherit the fix. httpClient.ts was not edited by this unit.

Capability checks pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/history.spec.ts and the Play dev-link walkthrough were not run: tests/e2e/history.spec.ts does not exist yet (owned by integration/test units) and no preview is running (.aioson/preview.json absent). They are deferred integration evidence, not this unit's Done when.

messages.text: pnpm build fails only on server/report/pdfRenderer.ts(300,9) TS2322: a Buffer is passed where PDFKit's info option expects a string. Fix it there; the frontend history unit builds clean otherwise.

Run pnpm build after phase-2-backend-report fixes pdfRenderer.ts; then write/run tests/e2e/history.spec.ts. Selectors: company page ul[data-aioson-id=company-timeline] with li[data-row-id][data-status=draft|completed|archived]; buttons data-action=diag-archive|diag-restore|diag-discard (aria-label 'Arquivar diagnóstico de dd/mm/aaaa' / 'Restaurar diagnóstico de ...'); archived list in details[data-aioson-id=company-archived-diagnoses]; dialogs data-aioson-id=diagnosis-archive-confirm|diagnosis-restore-confirm|diagnosis-discard-confirm (ConfirmDialog, verbs 'Arquivar diagnóstico' / 'Restaurar diagnóstico' / 'Descartar rascunho' + 'Cancelar'); notices in role=status. 'Comparar' link only when TimelineEntry.canCompare. Result page link a[data-aioson-id=result-compare] 'Comparar com {mês}'. Compare page #/comparar/:id: article[data-aioson-id=compare], table[data-aioson-id=compare-table] rows tr[data-dimension] with span[data-direction=up|down|same] text '+N subiu' / '−N caiu' / '0 igual'; recalc notice p[role=note][data-aioson-id=compare-rules]; risks sections compare-risks-resolved / compare-risks-new; 409 no_previous_diagnosis renders StatusView data-aioson-id=compare-empty.

CompanyPage no longer renders the CompanyDiagnosesSummary card (data-aioson-id=company-diagnoses); it renders the 'novo diagnóstico começa com as respostas de...' note plus CompanyTimeline, and the empty state data-aioson-id=company-empty is shown when there is no draft and no active completed diagnosis (archived ones still appear folded). Any older e2e selecting company-diagnoses must move to company-timeline.
ResultPage header now has a right-side actions div (inside ResultHeader) holding CompareWithLink; put the 'Exportar PDF' button next to it there.
